description: Verso: Response from Moshe b. Levi ha-Levi, probably in Qalyūb, to his brother Yedutun, probably in Fustat. Instructing him to have Ibn Abū l-ʿAysh take care of the matter of the cauldron (dast) discussed on recto: "pay him a dirham or more to have him fix it and fix its roundness" (i.e., the defect mentioned on recto must have been a dent, as Goitein suggested on his index card). Moshe has received the container of rose containing some cypress nuts (jawz sarw). He instructs him to settle accounts with Ibn al-Dajājī. This sections mentions two distinct varieties of cinnamon (salīkha and qirfa) and agrimony juice (ʿaṣārat ghāfit). Also mentions the price of the linseed oil that someone had advanced to Mūsā. (Information in part from Goitein's index cards.) EMS/OZ/ASE
description_he: מכתב ביהודית-ערבית מ-Qalyūb לפוסטאט. מוחזק בספריית קיימברידג'.
